body.statement:
Under independent multinomial sampling, at every fixed interior observable coordinate \(\zeta\), the reduced empirical-frequency vector satisfies
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat\zeta_n-\zeta)\Rightarrow N(0,\Omega_{\zeta}),
\qquad
\widehat\Omega_n\xrightarrow{P}\Omega_{\zeta},
\]
where, for two independent multinomial samples with \(n/n_m\to\lambda\in(0,\infty)\), the joint covariance is block diagonal and the margin block is multiplied by \(\lambda\). Continuously differentiable maps obey the multivariate delta method, and an interior multinomial log likelihood is locally asymptotically quadratic.

attestation.note: Used only for the finite-dimensional central limit, delta-method, and LAN substrate; compact-uniform chart and Hausdorff conclusions are derived in this solve.
